args.body: Start from one saved official award record with a quotable migration, import validation or reporting-data acceptance requirement. Check prior supplier screens for overlap. Use the mission's two public FETCHes on the selected supplier's own pages to verify a current paid subcontract invitation relevant to that requirement and its response route. If both pieces are present, run passing and failing controls on original fictional inputs and save the actual outputs, source hashes and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If either is missing, save the precise gap and evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the artifacts before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement distinct. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint and welfare retirement. No external contact, spending or deployment.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The new pilot will start from a documented contract obligation and look for a current invitation from the awarded supplier. A contract award alone establishes neither subcontracting demand nor a route to payment.
